notes: v3.65.64 (Sep: 'Doi voi tau dang quan ly: so du thuc cung bao gom chi du kien (thong nhat chung)'): mo rong logic v3.65.62 (truoc chi ap dung cho tau da cham dut QL) sang MOI tau - cot 'So du hien tai' o bang Trang thai so du (Hub tau) luon hien = bal (da tru chi du kien), khong con dung balReal (chua tru) nua, bo dong phu 'sau du kien' vi da la 1 so duy nhat. Trang thai DUOI NGUONG/AN TOAN cung xet theo dung so dang hien (bal) de mau khop voi so. Ap dung dong bo ca dong tau don le lan dong TONG theo chu tau (gop nhieu tau). Rieng nhan 'Chua du ho so' vs 'Du kien them' va cot Nguong/Trang thai an/hien van giu phan biet theo tau da cham dut hay chua (y nghia khac nhau ve ban chat).
